scripts.ast-grep:test: pnpm run ast-grep:rules:test && pnpm exec ast-grep test --config sgconfig.yml
scripts.ast-grep:validate: pnpm run ast-grep:test && pnpm exec ast-grep scan --config sgconfig.yml --error=unused-suppression --error=no-suppress-all --json=compact --color never .
scripts.check:ci: pnpm run ast-grep:validate && uv run --locked ruff check . && uv run --locked ruff format --check . && uv run --locked pyright
scripts.check:structural-policy: pnpm run ast-grep:validate && pnpm run check:hooks
scripts.soleaux:lint: uv run --locked ruff check . && uv run --locked ruff format --check .
scripts.soleaux:rust:check: cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --locked && cargo build --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --release --locked
scripts.test:unit: uv run --locked pytest && vitest run scripts/soleaux/
